verdict.rationale: monday.com's developer platform says apps deploy to "isolated sandboxes monday manages" (monday-docs-5). It also says agents can "promote versions from chat" (monday-docs-17), which implies some separation between development and live versions. However, the sandbox wording describes isolated hosted runtime infrastructure, not a test environment with non-production data. Nothing shows test data being kept apart from a production account's boards. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or developer account with separate test data, explicit dev/staging vs production data isolation, guidance on testing agents or API calls without affecting live boards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
